bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. All bags are searched, and bags that are not clear get an additional search.
prohibited: Weapons, pepper spray and replica weapons
Personal video cameras, GoPros, selfie sticks and drones
Professional audio or video equipment, detachable lenses and tripods
Laser pointers and full face masks
Glow sticks, poi, hoops and bitwhips
bagPolicy.note: Prescription medication is allowed in its original container with a name that matches your photo ID. The venue cannot store medication.

parking.note: There are several pay parking lots around Summit Music Hall with varying costs. Street parking is available but limited to 2 hours due to parking meters.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Summit Music Hall's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Summit Music Hall offers pizza by the slice from Marquis Pizza, including options for pepperoni, cheese, and garlic knots in original or vegan recipes. A wide variety of beverages are available at bars throughout the venue.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Summit Music Hall, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Summit Music Hall's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Summit Music Hall. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Summit Music Hall. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.

glance.label: Bags
glance.value: Bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed
